# Fast Frame Plot

## What it does
Plots one signal from a selected CSV file, either as `Y vs time/sample` or `X vs Y`.

## Creation (settings)
- CSV Directory: Directory used to list available `.csv` files in the widget.
- CSV File Path: CSV file to read and watch for updates.
- Refresh Rate: Poll interval used to reload the selected file.
- Plot Mode: `Y vs Time` or `X vs Y`.
- Time Column: Optional X axis column for time-series mode. If left empty, the widget uses the row index.
- X Variable / Y Variable: Variables selected from the CSV header.
- Title: Widget title.

## Usage (in dashboard)
- Point the widget at a CSV file generated by the fast-frame workflow.
- Choose the variable to plot on the Y axis.
- For `Y vs Time`, optionally choose a time column; otherwise the widget uses the row index.
- For `X vs Y`, choose both X and Y variables from the same CSV.
- The plot reloads automatically when the selected CSV file is overwritten or appended with the same variables.
- `k_acquire` is ignored in the selector list, and `V_Low_estim` is added automatically when `duty_cycle` and `V_high` are present.
